name: Sadahalli
tagline: An airport-side search with a village address of its own.
description: Sadahalli is part of North Bengaluru’s airport-side property search area, with Sadahalli Gate and the NH 44 connection acting as familiar route anchors. Nearby Navarathna Agrahara is a separate village address used by Bhartiya Garden Estate. The quarry temple is a distinctive landmark associated with Sadahalli.
